detail.longDescription: Trying to not use reCharts' many : any types, and failing. Is this possible? I have a very simple type for my payload that I have to inject in a few event handlers' parameter types. Some are straightforward, a simple Omit, but others are deeply nested in subtypes I cannot even reference. For example, custom dot is very easy: type MyActiveDotProps = Omit<ActiveDotProps, 'payload' | 'value'> & { payload :MyPayload value :number }; ... const CustomLinkDot = ({ cx, cy, payload } :MyActiveDotProps) => { ... <Line activeDot={CustomLinkDot} > but tooltip seems impossible: type MyTooltipContentProps = Omit<TooltipContentProps<ValueType, NameType>, 'payload'> & { // NOTE: this type have payload field, that itself has a payload field! // payload[0].payload !!! // //label?: string | number; //payload: TooltipPayload; //coordinate: Coordinate | undefined; //active: boolean; //accessibilityLayer: boolean; //activeIndex: TooltipIndex | undefined; // ^ no need to override all these, we are getting from original with Omit above (only payload is removed, but it is NOT OUR payload) // Now the original payload for the payload is not referenceable. so try to recreate: payload: ReadonlyArray<{ dataKey :string value :number name :string payload :MyPayload /* ex original fields: * "stroke": "#3182bd", * "strokeWidth": 1, * "fill": "#fff", * "dataKey": "measured", * "name": "measured", * "hide": false, * "color": "#3182bd", * "graphicalItemId": "recharts-line-_r_2_", * "payload": { >>> NOTE: the payload has a payload... * "collect": "2026-03-17T00:00:00.000Z", * "eventId": 14, * "measured": 72 * }, * "value": 72 */ }> }; ... const CustomTooltip = ({ active, payload } :MyTooltipContentProps) => { ... <Tooltip trigger="hover" wrapperStyle={{ top: -150, left: 0, pointerEvents: 'auto' }} content={CustomTooltip} /> > Type '({ active, payload }: MyTooltipContentProps) =\> JSX.Element | undefined' is not assignable to type 'ContentType\<ValueType, NameType\> | undefined'. > Type '({ active, payload }: MyTooltipContentProps) =\> JSX.Element | undefined' is not assignable to type '(props: TooltipContentProps\<ValueType, NameType\>) =\> ReactNode'. > Types of parameters '\__0' and 'props' are incompatible. > Type 'TooltipContentProps\<ValueType, NameType\>' is not assignable to type 'MyTooltipContentProps'. > Type 'TooltipContentProps\<ValueType, NameType\>' is not assignable to type '{ payload: readonly { dataKey: string; value: number; name: string; payload: MyPayload; }\[\]; }'. > Types of property 'payload' are incompatible. > Type 'TooltipPayload' is not assignable to type 'readonly { dataKey: string; value: number; name: string; payload: MyPayload; }\[\]'. > Type 'TooltipPayloadEntry' is not assignable to type '{ dataKey: string; value: number; name: string; payload: MyPayload; }'. > Types of property 'dataKey' are incompatible. > Type 'string | number | ((obj: any) =\> any) | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'. > Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string'. It will complain about all types I overrode that it uses internally when all I needed was to override only the internal payload property.
